title: 第15章 君家有女君怡雪第16章 君傲天 你是在打我脸
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: 君家族老也附和道：
“林家资源岂能跟君家比，更何况那小子在林家并不待见，虽然林家向外公布说林小子先天性不足，才无法修炼。
但据我们君家暗中调查，那小子可是天生大道圣体，只是被挖了大道圣心，移植到了林家的另一子身上”
“没错，另一子名叫林浩宇，其母是叶家的旁亲，据说当时移植的还是叶家的叶振声动手呢”
君家的族老各个都发表自己的所知与看法。
十七神轻叹一声，缓缓的回忆道：
“林家的林枫准帝也算是一代豪杰，凭一手【八荒剑经】硬击大帝，开创林家传承至今。
想不到后代竟然这么堕落，靠毁灭后辈子弟的未来，来换得苟延残喘，我君家绝不会如此自掘坟墓，也绝不允许，他们都是君家的未来，你们明白了吗”。
“是，谨遵十七祖训示”众族老应声。
“老十七，你说若是修复好林小子的大道圣心，那君家岂不是又添一名圣体？大道圣体比之荒古圣体，也差不到哪去吧！”
十八祖摸着下巴，沉吟道；
“嗯？又添一名圣体？这话让众族老心中一震，君家出一名荒古圣体就让天荒皆惊，若再……”。
“有情，你怎么看？”十七祖眼中亮光一闪，但并没有拍板，是看向君有情。
君有情认真评估了下，沉声道：
“十七祖，十八祖，如果雪儿对林小子有意，而林小子又愿意入我君家，我觉得事情大有可为”。
“你们怎么看？”十八祖也问向君家的众族老。
一名德高望重的族老缓缓开口：
“十七祖，十八祖，家主说的不错，我觉得也可行，俗话说女婿半个儿，更何况林小子是直接上门，那更是君家人无疑了。
若真能解决林小子的缺陷，那我君家这一代就有两人领军，君家以后再度辉煌百万年那是毫无疑问”。
“没错，我等皆认同”君家众族老意见一致。
十八祖，十七祖两人相视一眼，便拍板道：
“那明天就让林小子，与雪丫头一起来齐天宫，看两人什么意见，若是互相没问题，那就这么定了，后天就举行大婚”。
“甚好”众族老高声附议；
雪灵小筑
“小姐，外面都传林家公子已经来到了君家，就等后天完成大婚了，小姐打算怎么办”。
content_en:
The elder of the Jun family also echoed:
"How can the Lin family's resources be compared to the Jun family's? What's more, that boy is not welcome in the Lin family, even though the Lin family announced to the outside world that Lin's congenital deficiencies prevented him from cultivating.
But according to the secret investigation of our Jun family, that boy was born with the holy body of the Dao, but he had the Sacred Heart of the Dao dug up and transplanted it into another son of the Lin family."
"Yes, the other son's name is Lin Haoyu, and his mother is a relative of the Ye family. It is said that the transplant was performed by Ye Zhensheng of the Ye family."
Each of the elders of the Jun family expressed their own knowledge and opinions.
Seventeen Gods sighed softly and recalled slowly:
"The quasi-emperor Lin Feng of the Lin family can be regarded as a hero of the generation. He defeated the great emperor with his [Eight Desolate Sword Manual] and created the Lin family's legacy to this day.
I never expected that future generations would be so depraved, relying on destroying the future of their descendants in order to survive. Our Jun family will never dig their own graves like this, and we will never allow it. They are all the future of the Jun family, do you understand?"
"Yes, I sincerely follow the instructions of the Seventeenth Ancestor" the elders from all clans responded.
"Old Seventeen, you said that if Mr. Lin's Sacred Heart of the Dao is restored, wouldn't that mean that the Jun family will have another Saint? The Saint of the Dao is not much different from the Ancient Saint!"
The Eighteenth Patriarch touched his chin and said in deep thought;
"Huh? Add another Holy Body? These words shocked the hearts of all the elders of the clans. The appearance of an ancient Holy Body in the Jun family will shock everyone. If it happens again...".
"Youqing, what do you think?" The Seventeenth Patriarch's eyes flashed, but he did not make a decision. He looked at Jun Youqing.
Jun Youqing carefully evaluated it and said in a deep voice:
"Seventeenth Ancestor, Eighteenth Ancestor, if Xue'er is interested in Mr. Lin, and Mr. Lin is willing to join my Jun family, I think there is a lot to be done."
"What do you think?" The Eighteenth Patriarch also asked the elders of the Xiangjun family.
A respected clan elder spoke slowly:
"Seventeenth Ancestor, Eighteenth Ancestor, the head of the family is right, and I think it is feasible. As the saying goes, a son-in-law is half a son. What's more, if Mr. Lin comes directly to the door, he is undoubtedly from the Jun family.
If the shortcomings of Mr. Lin can really be solved, then there will be two people in this generation of my Jun family, and there is no doubt that the Jun family will be glorious again for millions of years in the future."
"That's right, we all agree." The elders of the Jun family all agreed.
The Eighteenth Patriarch and the Seventeenth Patriarch looked at each other and then said:
"Then let Mr. Lin and Xue Yatou come to Qitian Palace tomorrow to see what their opinions are. If there is no problem with each other, then it is settled and the wedding will be held the day after tomorrow."
"Very good" all the clan elders agreed loudly;
Xueling Xiaozhu
"Miss, there are rumors that Young Master Lin has arrived at Jun's house and will be getting married the day after tomorrow. What do you plan to do, Miss?"
title_en: Chapter 15 There is a daughter in the Jun family, Jun Yixue Chapter 16 Jun Aotian, you are slapping me in the face
